title: build.zig 'test-integration-env' step name implies a scoped ENV-01..05 subset but actually compiles and runs the full ~700-test integration suite
notes: Discovered while diagnosing rework of ISS-0100 (GitHub #357) after TEST-RUNNER's Step 5 FAIL. TEST-RUNNER attempted to verify db_integration_test.zig's TC-DB-01-01/TC-DB-01-02 in isolation from tests/integration/adp04b_tenant_realm_binding_test.zig and tm01_tenant_list_test.zig by running `zig build test-integration-env`, believing the step name indicated a scoped ENV-01..05-only test subset that would exclude those files, giving 'zero cross-binary contention'. ISSUE-FIXER's rework-1 diagnosis (docs/issue-reports/ISS-0100-rework1-diagnosis.yaml, section separate_binary_hypothesis_ruled_out) found this belief was incorrect: build.zig defines a SEPARATE b.addTest() artifact `env_integration_tests` (around line 1414-1427, backing step test-integration-env) that ALSO uses root_source_file = 'tests/integration/main_test.zig' -- the exact same ~700-test root file as the primary `integration_tests` artifact (around line 838, backing the main test-integration step). Both steps compile and run the IDENTICAL full suite as two separate binaries/processes; test-integration-env is not a scoped subset despite its name. This directly caused TEST-RUNNER to report a false sense of isolation in its verification, costing a wasted verification cycle before the actual root cause (adp04b/tm0x fixture rows tripping the ISS-503 guard mid-suite) was correctly diagnosed.
candidate_resolution: Either (a) rename the test-integration-env build step to something that accurately reflects that it runs the full suite (e.g. if it exists only as a duplicate/parallel-execution lane, name it accordingly, such as test-integration-parallel2 or similar), or (b) give it a genuinely scoped root_module containing only the ENV-01..05 test files, analogous to how test-integration-svc already has its own dedicated svc_integration_tests artifact scoped to the SVC-0x test files. Needs its own scoping decision on which approach fits the original intent of this build step; not part of ISS-0100's fix.
